allow: PowerShell(Get-ChildItem env: | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'CLAUDE|ANTHROPIC|BEDROCK|AWS' } | Format-Table -AutoSize Name, Value)

PowerShell($user = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariables\('User'\); $machine = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariables\('Machine'\); Write-Output '=== USER scope ==='; $user.GetEnumerator\(\) | Where-Object { $_.Key -match 'CLAUDE|ANTHROPIC|BEDROCK|AWS' } | Format-Table -AutoSize Key, Value; Write-Output '=== MACHINE scope ==='; $machine.GetEnumerator\(\) | Where-Object { $_.Key -match 'CLAUDE|ANTHROPIC|BEDROCK|AWS' } | Format-Table -AutoSize Key, Value)
